title: Track Guide Okayama Short Mazda MX5 iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: braking marker at tire marks, 85% brake pressure
corners.exit: let car walk out to left side of track

corners.label: T2
corners.line: turn in before braking marker, end of gravel, close to inside curb

corners.label: T3
corners.line: get on red and white curb
corners.mistakes: turn in too early, exit wide in grass

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: use the fence here on the left as breaking marker, 80% brake pressure, ease off to curb
corners.line: turn in late, aim for mid track exit
corners.exit: throttle gradually, aim for mid track
corners.mistakes: go on throttle too early, go on grass

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: no clear breaking marker, 55% brake pressure, ease off to curb

corners.label: T6
corners.line: cut curb on inside, exit left side

corners.label: T7
corners.braking: use the wall here on the inside as breaking marker, 70% brake pressure, ease off to curb
corners.line: use all available flat curb on outside

general_tips: overtake in turn one and turn four in the race
use left side of track for turn two
